The unanchored_soft_exit entry should not cite 'call_shape.button_up' (that's the appointment-confirmation protocol for booked calls) \u2014 flag as a schema gap for DQ-exit procedure instead. Optionally strengthen by adding an explicit cherry_pick_moment for the 00:49 unprompted shade-concern raise (currently only mentioned inside trajectory_verdict), since it's the root of the whole disputed trajectory.
